page: Microsoft Azure E128-64ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadsv7 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with 32 physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. Additionally, the instance is equipped with 7559 GB of local NVMe storage and is Premium Storage capable, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong compute and memory performance. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng and PassMark CPU scores rank in the top 10% tier, supported by advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (VNNI and BF16) and cryptography accelerations like AES and SHA_NI. Multi-core performance and memory bandwidth are also highly competitive, with large-block memory read speeds reaching 206.52 GB/sec and write speeds at 133.04 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations demonstrate high throughput, with Redis achieving 101.98 million operations per second.

Given its high memory density and substantial local storage capacity, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, and data-heavy enterprise applications. The combination of high-frequency AMD EPYC cores and massive memory bandwidth makes it highly cost-efficient for in-memory databases, heavy ETL processing, and local-storage-dependent analytics. It also shows strong capability for CPU-based machine learning tasks, achieving top-tier performance in small to medium LLM inference benchmarks.
